## About
The Hangar Poker House is a private membership club in Humble, Texas, for people who want a safe, legal place to play poker. We run tournaments and a variety of cash games every day, and our professional dealers keep things fun, safe and discreet.
Big screens carry the latest games and fights, so you can follow your sports while you play. We're near Shamrocks Pub and Cafe East, which makes it easy to make a night of it.
Players have given us a 4.5 rating across 106 Google reviews. One reviewer called us a professionally run outfit in a cozy place, and another said every person working here is genuinely friendly and hospitable.

## Services
- Cash games: A variety of cash games running every day. One reviewer also mentioned enjoying Omaha games here.
- Tournaments: Tournament play for members. One first-time visitor said they had a lot of fun in the Sunday night tournament.
- Splash pots: Splash pots run every day at the club.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need a membership to play?
A: Yes. We are a private membership club, and membership is $10 a month.

Q: When do you close?
A: We open daily at noon, and we don't have a hard close time.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're right off 59 North and FM 1960 in Humble, near Shamrocks Pub and Cafe East.
